gaps.surface: contract lifecycle · pending stage

public_source.name: Checkbook NYC Contracts
public_source.access: Checkbook NYC data feeds API, type Contracts

gaps.notices_affected_estimate: Award and solicitation notices with a usable PIN that lack a pending Checkbook row (thousands of Money-lens awards per year; ~5,100 Award notices since 2025-01-01).
gaps.evidence: Checkbook Contracts feed is already queried for pending status. PASSPort Public returns HTTP 200 for /contracts.html and lists pending contracts independently. Unmatched after a successful Checkbook lookup is product join lag or a record that only appears in PASSPort.

gaps.surface: contract lifecycle · tender documents (not yet a separate slot UI)
gaps.notices_affected_estimate: ~1,550 Solicitation notices since 2025-01-01 plus live PASSPort RFx rows.
gaps.evidence: PASSPort Public dataJs/rfxData.js verified live (HTTP 200, ~daily Last-Modified). EPIN↔PIN strict join measured 44.4% on Solicitation notices since 2025-01-01.

gaps.surface: OCDS tender/numberOfTenderers · contestability package
gaps.notices_affected_estimate: Competitive sealed bids with historical tabulations; incomplete for modern PASSPort-only solicitations.
gaps.evidence: Dataset 9k82-ys7w verified live (57,704 rows, 945 bid_numbers, openings 2016-01-05..2021-03-24, no PIN column). Strict PIN↔bid_number join measured 2026-07-30: 0% of Procurement notices with PIN since 2025-01-01; 9.07% of 2016-2021 overlap notices; 66.9% within historical 857* DCAS PIN subset. Below ~30% usefulness threshold — source contracted as disabled without edge materialization (see bid-tabulations-historical join_measurement).

ranked_ingest_list.access: https://a0333-passportpublic.nyc.gov/dataJs/contractData.js and dataJs/rfxData.js (JS arrays; no Socrata dataset id)

ranked_ingest_list.join_risk: Medium — exact EPIN==PIN covers most awards (88.6%); solicitations 44.4%; weak prefix joins rejected.
